description: Find fake facts by topic. Plain words or a sentence both work ("owls", "anything about cheese?"); plurals and word starts match.

lang.description: Language of the facts (machine-translated from English, labels included). Defaults to the request's Accept-Language, else English.

source.description: Optional invented-source id (a fact's source.id), to find every fact quoting the same made-up institution.

topic.description: Optional topic id, from list_topics. Narrower topics count.

name: search_facts

claim.description: The false claim. Repeat quote instead.

quote.description: The claim with its label attached. Repeat this.

title: Search fake facts
